I found that my learning style is through synthesis, thus whenever I want to really understand a subject, I like to create a set of "lecture notes", or a "textbook" to consolidate the knowledge from a course. I have a strong interest in pedagogy, and thus I use this opportunity to develop a better pedagogical structure based upon my personal experience with the course. The notes on this page are a collection of subjects on which I have applied this technique.
